title: Probate Real Estate — Practitioner Testimony Operator Workbook
subtitle: Court Letters, Confirmation Sales, Inherited-House Decisions, and Cleanout-to-Listing Execution for Executors, Heirs, and Probate Agents

worksheets.title: Letters, Authority, and the Confirmation Sale
worksheets.purpose: Map the legal path from filing to certified letters, lock in the authority level that governs the sale, and run the court confirmation numbers so no listing, offer, or contract moves ahead of the court's actual grant of power over the estate property.
instructions: Work the fields in order, because every later decision depends on the letters date and the authority level the court actually granted.
Pull every date, name, and dollar figure from court papers, the clerk, or the estate account records, never from memory or a family member's guess.
Treat the will as a map of intent only; a title company will not sell the house through the will, so cite the letters for every authority claim.
Where the estate faces limited authority, complete the confirmation math in front of the heirs so the overbid floor and deposit rules surprise nobody in the courtroom.
Revisit the certified copies and letters dates every sixty days, and request updated letters from the clerk before any institution rejects a stale copy.

fields.name: letters_status_and_date
fields.prompt: Record whether certified letters testamentary or letters of administration have issued, the exact issuance date, the court that issued them, and the name of the appointed personal representative. Note why no listing, offer, or contract can happen before that date arrives.
fields.example: Letters of administration issued March 4 by the probate court naming the decedent's daughter as personal representative. Per RLS Law Corporation, the letters date is the date the property can be listed [RLS Law Corporation — lNaVAVnUZTE @ 00:13:25]. Letters also grant authority to deal with creditors and the mortgage company and sell the home [Wanda Rochelle, Probate Resource — Ghymi1mvrRQ @ 00:01:06].

fields.name: certified_copies_order
fields.prompt: List how many certified copies of the letters you will order at issuance, which institutions will receive one, and the date each copy was issued. Flag any institution likely to reject letters older than sixty to ninety days.
fields.example: Ordered eight certified copies at issuance because some institutions keep the copy they receive and requesting more later is harder [SwiftProbate — lAC-1ovhHAo @ 00:02:45]. Copies go to the bank, title company, insurer, mortgage servicer, and utility. Calendar reminder set at day 60 to request updated letters from the court clerk before any copy goes stale [SwiftProbate — lAC-1ovhHAo @ 00:03:29].

fields.name: filing_packet_checklist
fields.prompt: Inventory the opening filing packet for the decedent's county of domicile: original will, certified death certificate, petition, and fee. Note whether a simplified small-estate path such as an affidavit procedure or summary administration was asked about first.
fields.example: Packet assembled for the county where the decedent lived: original will, certified death certificate, signed petition, and filing fee. Before filing, the clerk was asked whether an affidavit procedure or summary administration fit this modest estate, which can save real time and fees [The Executor's Guide — HPpVk5fp1No @ 00:06:19]. Clerk's answer: full proceeding required for this estate.

fields.name: heir_and_relative_roster
fields.prompt: List every heir and relative named in the petition and notice, including anyone disinherited by the will, plus each heir's spouse. For each, confirm living, over 18, competent, and able to sign before anyone goes under contract.
fields.example: Roster: two daughters, one disinherited son, and two spouses, all living, over 18, and competent [The Real Estate Lawyer — ASuTQp-hvNU @ 00:02:07]. The disinherited son stays in the petition because DeGrazia calls the omission the most common avoidable mistake and says the judge will continue the hearing [California Probate Real Estate Made Simple — lrpGu0nZK1E @ 00:05:06].

fields.name: notice_and_publication_proof
fields.prompt: Document how heirs were notified and how publication was handled, who mailed the DE121 notice, and when proof of mailing was filed. Record the hearing date and any continuance risk created by a missing or defective notice.
fields.example: The DE121 notice was mailed to every heir and relative, including the disinherited son, by a neighbor who is not a party, and proof was filed [California Probate Real Estate Made Simple — lrpGu0nZK1E @ 00:06:25]. Publication ran in the local newspaper ahead of the hearing. Hearing set for June 12; no continuance expected because no relative was left off.

fields.name: authority_level_requested
fields.prompt: State whether full Independent Administration of Estates Act authority or limited authority was requested and granted. Describe what that level means for selling the real property, including how many court hearings and approvals the estate should expect before closing.
fields.example: Full IAEA authority requested at filing and granted, so the representative can manage and sell the house with far fewer court hearings [California Probate Real Estate Made Simple — lrpGu0nZK1E @ 00:04:14]. Heyman estimates 90 to 95 percent of probates carry full authority, with escrows running 18 to 30 days [Sell a House in Probate California | Brendan Mohr — G-_4Dz5R2z8 @ 00:01:33].

fields.name: timeline_and_creditor_clock
fields.prompt: Project the realistic timeline from filing to letters and from letters to distribution, naming the creditor period that drives it. Write the date the creditor window closes and how that date shapes when sale proceeds can reach heirs.
fields.example: Letters expected two to six weeks after filing in this straightforward case [SwiftProbate — lAC-1ovhHAo @ 00:03:49]. Renee Speakerman never quotes California probates shorter than nine months, averaging one to one and a half years to distribution, driven by the four-month creditor period running from letters [RLS Law Corporation — lNaVAVnUZTE @ 00:03:28]. Creditor window closes four months after letters.

fields.name: estate_account_and_debt_priority
fields.prompt: Record the estate EIN, the bank holding the estate account, and the order in which debts will be paid. Confirm no estate money moves through the decedent's personal accounts and explain the personal liability risk of paying out of order.
fields.example: EIN obtained the week letters issued; estate checking opened under that EIN, and every bill runs through it [NOVA Real Estate Solutions — JG6VKzYq_uA @ 00:07:06]. Debts are queued in statutory priority order because paying out of order may leave the personal representative personally liable [NOVA Real Estate Solutions — JG6VKzYq_uA @ 00:10:59]. The decedent's old checking account stays untouched.

fields.name: confirmation_math_and_overbid
fields.prompt: If the sale requires court confirmation, calculate the opening overbid from the accepted price, the ninety percent appraisal floor, and the deposit bidders must bring. Show the arithmetic so heirs and buyers see the courtroom numbers before the hearing.
fields.example: Accepted offer: $500,000. Opening overbid equals the accepted price plus ten percent of the first $10,000 and five percent of the balance, so $525,500 [Win-Win Realtors TV — nenCgIcDQpw @ 00:01:59]. Limited authority means no sale below 90% of appraised value [Aronsohn & So, Probate Real Estate — Ivp-A8gsOnI @ 00:00:19]. Bidders bring cashier's checks for 10 percent.

fields.name: second_marketing_and_court_order
fields.prompt: Describe how the property will be marketed a second time for the confirmation hearing, what goes in the agent remarks, and who will chase the certified court order to title. Note whether the contract was frozen before the petition and publication.
fields.example: Agent remarks list the hearing date, court location, court number, and room number, with an offer to coach overbidders [Bill Gross, the LA Probate Expert — ih5FQvZZVck @ 00:06:45]. Contingencies and the closing-cost credit were settled before the petition went out [Sell a House in Probate California | Brendan Mohr — Gz6Ih7tLzdQ @ 00:13:33]. The probate attorney's office chases the certified order.

worksheets.completion_gate: Certified letters are in hand with a recorded issuance date, every heir and relative including disinherited ones appears in the petition with filed proof of notice, an estate account runs under its own EIN, and the authority level and any confirmation math are written down before any listing, offer, or contract.

worksheets.title: The Inherited House Decision File
worksheets.purpose: Lock the inherited house's tax basis, protect the vacant asset, surface every lien and government claim, and settle the heirs' path to sale or buyout before a single dollar of repair money or a single contract signature commits the estate.
instructions: Order the professional date-of-death appraisal first; every basis, buyout, and pricing number in this worksheet rests on that one valuation.
Call the insurance carrier and change the locks within days of vacancy, because coverage and security gaps open long before the heirs agree on anything.
Request every claim, lien status, and waiver answer on paper with a date, never over the phone, and attach each one to the field it supports.
Run the carrying-cost and buyout math in front of all heirs together so no sibling negotiates privately on numbers the others have never seen.
Send any deed change, gift, or title edit to an attorney before it happens, since a careless transfer can trigger an ineligibility penalty or forfeit the step-up.

fields.name: date_of_death_appraisal
fields.prompt: Name the professional appraiser hired for the date-of-death valuation, the order date, the appraised value, and how far inside the first sixty days it landed. State why online estimates cannot substitute when the IRS reviews basis.
fields.example: Appraisal ordered on day 22 after death and completed at $800,000. Garcia says a Zillow or Redfin estimate does not count and the IRS wants a real appraisal, a step Garcia credits with saving clients over $40,000 [Tricia Garcia Real Estate — qNeCeQehzRg @ 00:03:38]. Assessed value was rejected as a huge mistake [Probate Mastery — evd32pAim5s @ 00:52:46].

fields.name: step_up_basis_math
fields.prompt: Write the step-up calculation: original purchase price, date-of-death basis, expected sale price, and resulting taxable gain. Note any lifetime gift or irrevocable trust transfer that could forfeit the step-up, and whether the reset could run downward instead.
fields.example: Parents bought for about $200,000; date-of-death basis is $800,000; sale at $800,000 leaves $0 taxable gain instead of the CPA's roughly $180,000 estimate [Tricia Garcia Real Estate — qNeCeQehzRg @ 00:03:15]. The home is treated as held more than a year, and the reset can also be a step-down [The Legacy Desk — qlBYQPngO0o @ 00:03:05]. No lifetime gift occurred.

fields.name: vacancy_insurance_and_security
fields.prompt: Record the date the carrier was told the house is vacant, the vacant policy now bound, and every physical security step taken. Include locks, alarm codes, garage remotes, crawl space, and any police patrol request for the empty property.
fields.example: Carrier notified on day 12, well before standard policies quietly stop covering a property vacant 30 to 60 days [Sell That Wreck! With Stephanie Burt — 6xUa7KjeSSY @ 00:01:35]. Locks, alarm codes, and garage remotes changed [Selling Inherited Property - The Prepared Heir — rnWBVJVgbTw @ 00:01:00]. Crawl space sealed against squatters and the house added to the local police patrol route.

fields.name: carrying_cost_burn
fields.prompt: Total the monthly carrying costs on the inherited house: property taxes, utilities, insurance, and basic maintenance. Multiply across the months heirs expect to debate, then note what deferred-maintenance damage could add once indecision runs past six months.
fields.example: Taxes, utilities, vacant-home insurance, and lawn care run about $750 a month, or $4,500 over six months, squarely inside Burt's $3,000 to $6,000 range before the real damage begins [Sell That Wreck! With Stephanie Burt — 6xUa7KjeSSY @ 00:04:23]. Holding past six months risks deferred-maintenance damage, so the heirs agreed to a decision deadline of August 1.

fields.name: title_search_and_liens
fields.prompt: List what the title search ordered through the probate attorney surfaced: liens, unpaid taxes, judgments, HOA special assessments, mortgage balance, and any reverse mortgage payoff. Note the date ordered and how each item changes the net to heirs.
fields.example: Title search ordered through the probate attorney the week letters issued, surfacing one judgment lien and an unpaid HOA special assessment before any plan was built on the numbers [Sell That Wreck! With Stephanie Burt — 6xUa7KjeSSY @ 00:03:32]. A reverse mortgage balance appeared; it must be paid off at closing [Simplify Senior Transitions with Dale Corpus — S5zYm8kcrug @ 00:01:54].

fields.name: repair_or_as_is_decision
fields.prompt: Capture the experienced agent's evaluation before any repair money is spent. List each proposed improvement, whether buyers actually need it, and the final decision to sell as-is or repair, with the reasoning written in the heirs' own words.
fields.example: One heir wanted a new kitchen, fresh vanities, new flooring, and white paint throughout. The agent walked the house first and advised against all four until buyers showed they needed them [Horizon Real Estate & Probate and Trust Help — lo2f0qbkjaQ @ 00:04:21]. Decision: sell as-is, because, in the heirs' words, 'the market decides the value, not our memories.'

fields.name: sibling_buyout_financing
fields.prompt: If one heir wants to buy out the others, record the neutral appraisal used, the inherited share's value, and the mortgage broker's written answer on financing. Confirm the buying heir can afford to live there after closing.
fields.example: A $600 neutral appraisal set the house at $480,000, making each of three shares $160,000. Before any sibling negotiation, a mortgage broker confirmed how the inherited share is treated and what the buyer qualifies for [Michelle Bell - Realtor — F1mwNdsm-HA @ 00:06:01]. The buying sibling also confirmed the monthly cost of living there [Michelle Bell - Realtor — F1mwNdsm-HA @ 00:06:42].

fields.name: heir_communication_cadence
fields.prompt: Set the beneficiary update schedule: channel, frequency, length, and who drafts it. Identify which weekly agent report feeds each update and which heirs need extra attention, including minors, estranged siblings, and anyone who has called upset.
fields.example: Every other Friday, the executor sends a two- to three-minute email to four beneficiaries built from the agent's weekly update, heading off 15- to 20-minute calls from an upset heir [Horizon Real Estate & Probate and Trust Help — lo2f0qbkjaQ @ 00:06:15]. The estranged sister is copied on everything, since family dynamics are the biggest file challenge [Carolynn Castillo — XN-9ankgVNk @ 00:24:29].

fields.name: medicaid_claim_and_waiver
fields.prompt: If the decedent received long-term care Medicaid, record the itemized claim amount, the date the statement arrived on paper, and any spousal, minor child, disabled child, caregiver child, or undue hardship exemption pursued, with the waiver deadline counted in days.
fields.example: Itemized Medicaid statement received on paper September 3 showing a $64,000 claim, requested before pricing because the claim is paid from the sale [MarcCormier — t0-A8dVrr1o @ 00:04:01]. The undue hardship waiver application was requested by name, with 45 days logged, since silence counts as consent [นพดล เกิดยิ้ม — X-vkv-PR3pY @ 00:12:35]. Caregiver-child proof file started covering 24 months.

fields.name: deed_vesting_and_heirs_property
fields.prompt: Pull the recorded deed from the county recorder and note exactly how title is vested. Flag survivorship vesting, a deceased owner with no recorded probate or affidavit of heirship, any fractional interests, and whether a reverse mortgage or trust affects transfer.
fields.example: Recorder copy shows title still in the grandfather's name with no probate or affidavit of heirship recorded, which means heirs property where every co-owner must sign [The Accidental Executor — JsLnTFCaOUQ @ 00:02:26]. Investors can buy a 2% share for a few hundred dollars and force a partition auction [The Accidental Executor — JsLnTFCaOUQ @ 00:01:50], so every cousin gets contacted now.

worksheets.completion_gate: A professional date-of-death appraisal, a bound vacant-home policy, a completed title search, any itemized Medicaid claim with its waiver deadline, and a written exit decision agreed by every heir are all on file before pricing, repairs, or a buyout offer.

worksheets.title: Cleanout, Preservation, and the Probate Listing Launch
worksheets.purpose: Clear, protect, and inventory the estate's contents under proper signing authority, then build the listing side of the file so the representative, every beneficiary, and every contract amendment are verified before the property reaches the market.
instructions: Get the signature of the person with legal authority before any hauler, liquidator, or family member removes a single item from the house.
Photograph every space and complete the one-pass valuables search before scheduling any estate sale, buyout, or junk removal appointment.
Price every contents option side by side, including DIY sale, hired company, and cleanout, using the load-plus-labor method for hauling quotes.
Confirm the court-appointed representative and issued letters against the court record before any MLS entry, yard sign, or door hanger goes up.
Copy the probate attorney on every addendum and read each amendment against the court papers, logging the date each document was reviewed.

fields.name: signing_authority_for_contents
fields.prompt: Name the person holding legal authority over the house contents, the document that grants it, and the date that person signed off on removal. If two heirs share authority, record both signatures before a single item leaves the house.
fields.example: The personal representative, holding letters issued May 2, signed the cleanout authorization on May 9; nobody loads a truck until that person signs [JunkRemovalWeb — L8fzGwXd_kk @ 00:05:35]. Because the two daughters co-inherit the contents, both signed the same removal sheet before any item went out [Gyd Path — AMYbwbqYqY8 @ 00:05:41]. Signed copies sit in the estate file.

fields.name: room_by_room_photo_inventory
fields.prompt: Log the photo and video inventory: every room, closet, garage, shed, and outbuilding, with the date captured and where files are stored. Note any item flagged for a professional appraiser because it appears valuable or unique before contents move.
fields.example: Video walk-through recorded May 10 covering nine rooms, four closets, the garage, and the backyard shed as a preliminary inventory before contents moved [Local Probate Help — Bggg_tJ_y2g @ 00:03:10]. Files stored in a shared estate folder all heirs can view. A grandfather clock and coin binder were flagged for an appraiser [BizMove — ouKH71PUV3E @ 00:01:47].

fields.name: valuables_search_pass
fields.prompt: Describe the single search pass made before any disposal: books, coat pockets, high shelves, tins, and shoeboxes. Record who searched, how many days it took, what was found, and how each recovered item was logged and returned to the estate.
fields.example: Two heirs searched books, coat pockets, high shelves, tins, and shoeboxes over three days, knowing there is only one pass [Cesar Espinoza - Houston Probate Realtor — l68yR0_4B4g @ 00:02:32]. Found: a savings bond and $2,300 cash, deposited to the estate account. A hoarder sort elsewhere recovered $5,000 in jewelry and nearly $30,000 in cash [Illinois Probate Solutions — dHEXFlygm_8 @ 00:02:07].

fields.name: vacancy_tamper_checks
fields.prompt: List the tamper indicators and preservation supplies set at the vacant house, who checks them, and how often. Note lockbox placement, moisture control, keyhole seals, door markers, and what happens the first time a seal is found disturbed.
fields.example: Blue painter's tape covers each keyhole and an empty trash can sits in front of the back door; a broken seal or moved can signals entry [Property Preservation Insiders — 4pX2VabEor4 @ 00:22:20]. Lockbox and DampRid bought at about $5 each, not $13 retail [Property Preservation Insiders — 4pX2VabEor4 @ 01:16:06]. A neighbor checks weekly and texts photos.

fields.name: estate_sale_route
fields.prompt: Decide between a do-it-yourself estate sale, a hired estate sale company, or a buyout, and record the expected net of each. Note the vehicle listings, payment methods, and checkout rules planned if the family runs the sale itself.
fields.example: DIY sale chosen after Sam and Spencer turned $400 in expenses into well over $10,000 in one weekend [Smile Abroad with Sam & Spencer — q0NbvHAFXsA @ 00:15:03]. Both cars listed early to draw opening-morning buyers. Checkout accepts Venmo, PayPal, Zelle, and checks, and carts are held while buyers fetch cash [EstateSail | The All-In-One Estate Sale Manager — bx6BgPRa2JY @ 00:11:51].

fields.name: estate_sale_company_vetting
fields.prompt: If hiring an estate sale company, record the base minimum, the percentage of proceeds charged, and answers on advertising, payout timing, leftover items, and how valuables are secured. Compare at least two companies before anyone signs a contract.
fields.example: Company A quoted a base minimum plus 35% of proceeds, inside Whitehurst's 25-50%-or-more range [At Home with Jody — eQ9rTXDlJQM @ 00:08:32]. Each company was asked how and where it advertises, when the estate gets paid, what happens to leftovers, and whether valuables are secured [23ABC News | KERO — uvfLAJ4V3PM @ 00:01:09]. Company B refused written answers and was dropped.

fields.name: cleanout_quote_structure
fields.prompt: Break the cleanout quote into load price and labor price, with the number of loads, crew size, and man-hours allocated per load. Compare the total against published ranges so a slow, multi-load job cannot quietly blow up the estate's budget.
fields.example: Hauler quoted two loads plus labor at 4 man-hours per full load, 8 man-hours total, or about 1 hour 20 minutes per load for a three-person crew [JM Junk Removers — 0dYqJW59Zxg @ 00:06:56]. The labor charge protects margin on slow jobs [JM Junk Removers — 0dYqJW59Zxg @ 00:07:55]. Total sits inside JunkRemovalWeb's $1,000-$2,500 range for a 3BR.

fields.name: pr_verification_before_marketing
fields.prompt: Before any MLS entry, sign, or door hanger, confirm the court-appointed personal representative by name and the date letters issued. Note whether anyone pressed to sign a listing agreement before letters, and why that agreement would not hold.
fields.example: Court docket confirms the eldest son as personal representative, letters issued July 18; the MLS entry waited until then because a different PR can get appointed and hire someone else [Justin Stivers — Owbx6t3ocjM @ 00:10:10]. An heir asked to sign early, but an agreement signed before letters cannot hold anyone to anything [Probate Mastery — d-rZkDYaJhQ @ 00:51:22].

fields.name: beneficiary_map_and_call_priority
fields.prompt: Map every beneficiary, including minors and estranged siblings, with contact details and distance from the property. Rank outreach so out-of-area representatives come first, and note who will be called before any mail goes out to the family.
fields.example: The PR lives 300 miles away, so that file goes first; PRs more than 50 miles from the house find managing it a hassle [Probate Mastery — 7xCfSyqYEys @ 01:32:41]. Beneficiaries were pulled with the filing because listings have been won through siblings when the named executor could not be reached [The Aaron Novello Podcast — H-CW9uu5s-I @ 00:01:59]. Calls precede mail.

fields.name: contract_and_amendment_control
fields.prompt: Record how every amendment will be checked against the court papers, who has seller permission to call the buyer's lender, and how the probate attorney receives each addendum. Note the re-hearing risk if a concession change slips through unread.
fields.example: Each amendment is read line by line against the court papers, and the PR signed written permission to call the buyer's lender, since a missed concession change can force a two-week re-hearing [Probate Mastery — kvSTArlGoMU @ 00:25:30]. The attorney is treated like a transaction coordinator and copied on every addendum [Probate Mastery — lA-S6Qgcqwo @ 00:25:37].

worksheets.completion_gate: Signed removal authority, a dated photo inventory, a completed valuables search, a load-plus-labor cleanout quote, verified letters for the named representative, a full beneficiary map, and an amendment review routine are documented before contents leave or the listing goes live.

worksheets.title: Probate Business Blueprint and Attorney Referral Engine
worksheets.purpose: Build the two-prong probate business of direct family outreach plus an attorney referral network, with a funded runway, known lead costs, a value-first offer, and a nurture calendar that turns estate attorneys into steady listing sources.
instructions: Write your why, vendor team and 30-second USP before spending a dollar on marketing, because coached agents who jumped in haphazardly usually failed.
Enter real numbers for lead cost, close rate, and monthly budget, and plan around the conservative 2-3% coached conversion until your own results beat it.
Fund the runway before launch and keep probate a second channel until it produces 5-6 deals a month.
Approach attorneys in person with value before any ask, understate the volume you promise, and expect about a year and 10 visits before the first referral.
Copy referring attorneys on every addendum and update, and revisit this worksheet each quarter to compare projections against actual closings.

fields.name: written_why_and_usp
fields.prompt: Write your personal reason for entering the probate niche and a 30-second unique selling proposition you could say to a grieving personal representative. Explain how the statement leads with value and options rather than a one-sided lowball cash offer to the family.
fields.example: Chad Corbett warns that coached agents who jumped in haphazardly usually failed, so lock the written why, vendor team and USP first [Chad Corbett — jgstz7zruMg @ 00:05:14]. Sample USP: I help families settle an inherited house with several options, from listing to a quick sale, and I run a consultation, never a we-buy-houses pitch.

fields.name: full_time_focus_threshold
fields.prompt: Record how many probate deals you currently close each month and decide whether probate stays a side channel or becomes your main business. Name the monthly deal count you must reach before shifting full focus, and the single-source risk you face today.
fields.example: Current pace: two probate closings a month, both from one county list. Probate Mastery sets the bar at 5-6 deals a month before probate becomes the main business, because at one or two deals a single source can hand you a dry year [Probate Mastery — 7FoxQuVXm2k @ 00:02:34]. Probate stays a second channel until that threshold holds.

fields.name: runway_and_budget
fields.prompt: Calculate your per-county marketing budget and the cash runway you will hold before the first closing arrives. List monthly recurring costs, one-time setup costs, and the number of months you can survive with zero probate closings without abandoning the campaign.
fields.example: Chad Corbett's calculator prices one county at $813 a month recurring plus $700 one-time, about $3,000 for 267 leads over three months [Bill Gross, the LA Probate Expert — 4hp5f-_boUM @ 00:51:47]. Runway target: eight months, since David Pannell sat at zero closings for eight months before reaching 27 closings [Bill Gross, the LA Probate Expert — sy23pOWuMEU @ 00:25:49].

fields.name: lead_cost_and_close_rate
fields.prompt: Enter your fully loaded cost per probate lead, including list builders, callers, mailhouses and follow-up help, and your expected close rate on a cold list. State whether you are planning around a personal benchmark or a more conservative coached conversion figure.
fields.example: Bruce Hill spends $32 per lead against a $10-$20 market norm, roughly $2,800 a month on about 90 Fayetteville filings [Probate Mastery — 7FoxQuVXm2k @ 00:47:04]. Chad Corbett held a 6% close rate on a cold list [Beau Eckstein, Business Ownership Coach — cbWbIqZ3KnU @ 00:04:48]. Plan conservatively at 2-3%, the coached range, until your own numbers prove otherwise.

fields.name: call_script_review
fields.prompt: Describe how you will record, replay and tighten your probate conversations. Note the listening ratio you aim for, the words you will cut from your script, and how you will get the deal papered during the very first phone call with the family.
fields.example: Record and replay every call, then write out the script and trim the words [Probate Mastery — 6dyFJnKpQDI @ 00:20:24]. The more they talk, the more they trust [Probate Mastery — 6dyFJnKpQDI @ 00:26:15]. Close each call with paperwork in motion, because if it is not papered then, the paper is not coming [Bill Gross, the LA Probate Expert — 4hp5f-_boUM @ 00:35:22].

fields.name: listing_offer_structure
fields.prompt: Outline the listing offer you will present to probate families, including pricing strategy, the day you will begin reviewing offers, and any tiered or concierge fee options. Explain how the structure protects the estate's sale price while moving the house quickly.
fields.example: List 15% under market and review no offers until day 8; Chad Corbett averaged 8 days to sell in Roanoke even after volume dropped by two-thirds [Bill Gross, the LA Probate Expert — 4hp5f-_boUM @ 00:27:23]. Offer two tiers: a standard listing fee, and a concierge fee that covers coordination of the vendor bench for out-of-state heirs.

fields.name: attorney_target_list
fields.prompt: Build your list of probate and estate-planning attorneys to approach, noting where each name came from and how you will make first contact. Explain why in-person contact beats email or mail and what value you bring before you ask for anything.
fields.example: Pull names from the bar directory, then visit in person. Attorney Mike Rutkowski, 15 years in probate, said agents never reach out and it would be a breath of fresh air [Brandon Mulrenin — tHKQUQ1PDts @ 00:08:36]. Rutkowski puts real estate in 80-90% of probates [Brandon Mulrenin — tHKQUQ1PDts @ 00:20:37]. First value offered: ask what slows their probate files.

fields.name: value_first_offer
fields.prompt: Describe the specific service you will give an attorney before requesting a single referral, such as gopher help, sponsored lunches, or recorded interviews. Estimate what it costs you in dollars or hours and how often you will deliver it over the first year.
fields.example: Offer an overloaded solo attorney gopher time: fill out, drop off and file forms, and get documents notarized [Probate Mastery — g3dWuQ30j4Y @ 00:04:04]. Sponsor a lunch for about $250 [Probate Mastery — -lMVLigkZQI @ 00:37:32], then interview the attorney on Zoom and send the video to your sphere to manufacture referrals for them [Probate Mastery — 76c0h_es98E @ 00:03:07].

fields.name: nurture_cadence
fields.prompt: Map your attorney nurture calendar for the next twelve months, including visits, invitations, and updates. State the share of touches that will be invitations rather than requests, your email limits, and how you will avoid any gap that lets relationships go cold.
fields.example: Expect about a year and 10 visits before the first lead [Probate Mastery — evd32pAim5s @ 00:27:30]. Make 75% of outreach an invitation, like five-minute coffee or a small-group dinner [Probate Mastery — evd32pAim5s @ 00:36:30]. Never send five or six emails a day [Probate Mastery — kOa87jAYRNs @ 00:19:39], and never pause: Sarah's six-month gap left half the leads with another agent.

fields.name: transaction_updates_to_attorneys
fields.prompt: Explain how you will keep referring attorneys informed during each listing, including which documents you copy them on and how often you send property updates. Identify the date-of-death valuation service you will offer heirs and why market value matters for basis.
fields.example: Treat attorneys like your transaction coordinators and send every addendum, because Michelle's missed concession addendum forced a return to court [Probate Mastery — lA-S6Qgcqwo @ 00:25:37]. Send biweekly property updates. Run a free date-of-death BPO before heirs report basis, since using assessed value instead of market value is a huge mistake [Probate Mastery — evd32pAim5s @ 00:52:46].

worksheets.completion_gate: Complete when the written why, 30-second USP, per-county budget, eight-month runway figure, lead cost and close-rate assumptions, listing offer, a named list of target attorneys, a costed value-first offer, a twelve-month nurture calendar, and an attorney update protocol are all recorded with numbers.

worksheets.title: Probate Lead Data, Direct Mail, and Call Conversion System
worksheets.purpose: Turn raw county probate filings into conversations by pulling and scrubbing the right list, mailing help-first pieces on a funded drip, keeping phone lines clean, and running call-first scripts that surface every heir and decision-maker.
instructions: List each county, its source, cost and volume, and flag out-of-state representatives for priority treatment.
Assume a large share of raw data is flawed and build the scrub and skip-trace step before any mail drops.
Never open a letter or call with the death; lead with help, resources, and the family's hardest problem.
Commit to at least a six-month campaign on any new list, since one or two letters waste money and first touches are dismal.
Check caller ID, cap dials per number, and confirm every decision-maker before booking a listing appointment.

fields.name: county_list_source
fields.prompt: Name the counties you will work, the source of each probate list, its monthly cost, and the record volume. Note whether you pull the courthouse filings yourself or buy from a vendor, and which records you will prioritize first.
fields.example: David pays $2,200 a month for 1,100 records across 13 Dallas-Fort Worth counties and isolates 30-40 out-of-state representatives [Probate Mastery — pgW-G0oZoa4 @ 00:02:44], noting most deals come from people out of state [Probate Mastery — pgW-G0oZoa4 @ 00:01:26]. Skip counties that consistently file under 25 [Probate Mastery — uTFKO8zRNsI @ 01:05:36].

fields.name: scrub_and_skip_trace
fields.prompt: Describe your process for scrubbing raw probate leads and skip tracing personal representatives and heirs. State who does the scrubbing, how many records per day, how you handle flawed data, and whether non-real-estate leads still get called.
fields.example: An offshore VA scrubs 25 prospects a day. Assume 40% of the data is flawed [Probate Mastery — LaCR15esK0k @ 00:37:19]. Bruce Hill's funnel starts at 100 raw leads, about 70 with real estate [Probate Mastery — 3UwWnM4igSY @ 00:22:52], yet All The Leads says call every lead [All The Leads — D2NGOVJ2s6U @ 00:00:31].

fields.name: mail_piece_design
fields.prompt: Specify the format of your first probate mail piece, including envelope style, addressing method, postage type, and opening line. Explain how the opening offers help instead of condolences and avoids leading with the death of the family member.
fields.example: Use a hand-addressed greeting-card envelope in blue ink with a live first-class stamp, which pulls about 2% versus under 1% for #10 envelopes and postcards [All The Leads — 6iVpjQj9wjc @ 00:02:48]. Never open with the deceased, since leading with the death could be highly offensive [Realestate Doru — kVqHwTzx-bo @ 00:01:35]. Open with resources for the estate.

fields.name: drip_campaign_schedule
fields.prompt: Lay out your full follow-up mail sequence: number of touches, spacing between drops, total days, and per-recipient cost. Commit to a minimum campaign length on any new list and explain how you will stop charges once someone responds.
fields.example: Andy's PRINTgenie drip runs about $5 per recipient over roughly 112 days first class; 217 names times 5 pieces came to about $1,000 [Probate Mastery — IRtAt7-sQHc @ 00:28:01]. Run six months minimum on a new list [Probate Mastery — IRtAt7-sQHc @ 01:15:08], and delete respondents after each drop, as Bruce did with 4 people [Probate Mastery — IRtAt7-sQHc @ 01:11:57].

fields.name: merge_fields_and_tags
fields.prompt: Document how your mail platform maps names and tags records before launch. List which field holds the personal representative's first name, which holds the decedent's name, the tag that prevents duplicate mailings, and any merge fields you will never use.
fields.example: Map the personal representative's first name to first name and the deceased's first name to custom 2 [Probate Mastery — IRtAt7-sQHc @ 01:11:57]. Tag every record Direct Mail so it can be excluded later [BatchTV — xF9PxjJDUX0 @ 00:07:45]. Never put the (signature) merge field in the greeting, or your own name prints on every postcard [BatchTV — xF9PxjJDUX0 @ 00:03:47].

fields.name: call_first_economics
fields.prompt: Compare the cost and expected conversations of calling first versus mailing first on a batch of 100 probate leads. State your realistic live contact rate, your caller cost, and which approach anchors your pipeline for the first month.
fields.example: Bruce Hill gets about 50 conversations per 100 leads for roughly $400 of ISA cost, versus $900 for 600 mailers that pull inbound calls from about 5% [Probate Mastery — y1TInRM-Flc @ 00:00:43]. Dave Pinel tells new agents to expect live contact on about 10% of dials [Probate Mastery — URZzrpQSKmU @ 00:55:44]. Calling anchors month one.

fields.name: phone_line_hygiene
fields.prompt: Set the daily dial limit for each phone number, the services you rotate between, and the pre-session check you run on your caller ID. Explain how these steps prevent carriers from flagging your line as spam during a calling block.
fields.example: Keep each number under about 50 dials a day and rotate Line2, JustCall or Aircall numbers [All The Leads — KirkNi05zPU @ 00:37:37]. Before every session, call a non-contact and confirm what your caller ID displays, because Jim lost hours on about 100 calls to an undetected flag [All The Leads — P5kUaYnRKbo @ 00:08:24].

fields.name: opening_script_and_pivots
fields.prompt: Write your opening line for a cold probate call and two pivots for common put-offs, such as the attorney handling everything. Show how each pivot offers real value, such as insurance or resources, instead of pressing the family to sell immediately.
fields.example: Open with the family's hardest problem and ask to send a resource package. When told the attorney is handling everything, pivot to vacant-home insurance, since carriers can deny coverage after 30 days of vacancy and Lloyd's can insure within an hour [All The Leads — P5kUaYnRKbo @ 00:25:08]. Without value, nobody calls back [All The Leads — et_msiK8rvo @ 00:26:05].

fields.name: hidden_heir_and_decision_makers
fields.prompt: List the questions you will ask to uncover every heir, the realtor connection, and all decision-makers before booking an appointment. Explain how you confirm each decision-maker will attend by phone or in person and what you send ahead of time.
fields.example: Ask: no other family members are going to try to nose into this, are they? Bruce Hill says it brings the truth out most of the time [Probate Mastery — sVEhoM1KXUo @ 00:49:04]. Guess the realtor connection wrong on purpose [Probate Mastery — uTFKO8zRNsI @ 00:53:32]. Email PDF listing package ahead and require every decision-maker present [Probate Mastery — z0GTjTG76ls @ 00:07:33].

fields.name: follow_up_engine
fields.prompt: Describe your follow-up engine after the first conversation, including response time on inbound calls, how many dials happen on day one, and how long you nurture someone who holds you off. Name who on your team handles each follow-up task.
fields.example: Three dials on day one, inbound follow-up inside 15 minutes, and no asking permission to follow up [Probate Mastery — uTFKO8zRNsI @ 00:24:28]. Resistant PRs get about $61 of nurture over 6 to 8 months [Probate Mastery — kvSTArlGoMU @ 00:54:45], because three touches do not do it [Probate Mastery — dzqHqDnAl_E @ 00:06:02]. The VA runs follow-up; you run conversations.

worksheets.completion_gate: Complete when every worked county has a named source and cost, the scrub process has an owner and daily quota, the mail piece and drip schedule are priced per recipient, merge fields and tags are mapped, dial limits are set, scripts include two value pivots, and the follow-up owner is named.

worksheets.title: Probate Wholesale Execution and Senior Transition Sales
worksheets.purpose: Execute fresh-filing probate wholesale deals with enforceable paper and buyer access, then apply the same authority-first discipline to senior home sales and to any reinvestment of commissions into rentals or residential assisted living.
instructions: Work only fresh filings and reach the personal representative quickly, before inheritance-list buyers arrive.
Listen far more than you talk on the first call and hold price until the representative's problems are clear.
Anchor price, deposit, and terms first, then re-paper with a new date once letters issue so the contract can be enforced.
For senior sales, secure power of attorney or the senior's signature plus one family contact, and confirm every payoff before pricing.
Before reinvesting commissions, clear zoning for the exact address, the debt service coverage ratio, and the bed-fill marketing plan.

fields.name: fresh_filing_window
fields.prompt: Define the filing-date window you will pull for wholesale outreach and the source you will use. Explain why fresh filings beat older inheritance lists and how quickly you plan to reach each personal representative after the court filing.
fields.example: Pull only filings from the last 30 days and never go back more than 90, because inheritance lists cost thousands and are picked to death [Flip With Rick — e3YN7RJaj6U @ 00:59:35]. Rick Ginn puts it plainly: fresh probates is a must [Rick Ginn — LqNx0dBk2f8 @ 00:32:46]. Source: courthouse pull or XLeads, worked within 30 days.

fields.name: first_call_listening_plan
fields.prompt: Describe how you will run the first warm call with a personal representative, including your listening ratio and whether price comes up. Explain how you will build trust while keeping the conversation focused on the representative's problems rather than your offer.
fields.example: Run warm calls at 80/20 or 90/10 listening and give no price on the first call. Use the McDonald's/Burger King split, with different names on calls and letters, and leave a voicemail only on the third or fourth attempt [Flip With Rick — ZS8hjtChnG8 @ 00:23:13]. Remember that time kills all deals [Brent Daniels - Wholesaling Inc — wmbh_a5UnqI @ 00:23:51].

fields.name: price_deposit_terms_anchor
fields.prompt: Record the price, earnest money deposit, and sell-before-completion terms you will anchor with the personal representative before any attorney reviews the deal. Note the contract form you will use and confirm whether the assignability option is preserved in writing.
fields.example: Anchor price, an EMD of at least $500, and the sell-before-probate-completes terms with the PR before any lawyer reviews it, and keep the assignability box ticked [Flip With Rick — e3YN7RJaj6U @ 02:21:35]. Use the state-approved contract. Rick Ginn warns the attorney will kill your wholesale deal right off the bat [Rick Ginn — WU_DwL7k5ZE @ 00:36:55].

fields.name: letters_and_repapering
fields.prompt: Confirm whether the personal representative already holds letters of administration and describe how you will re-paper any early contract once they issue. Explain why an agreement signed before letters may not be enforceable and what dates the new paper carries.
fields.example: Confirm the PR holds letters of administration and re-paper the contract with a new date after they issue [Michael Franke — iJVCVwX-rmA @ 00:12:47]. Executors often start marketing before the property can be sold [Flipping Mastery TV — K_L_G6jbyAE @ 00:11:25]. Write a 6-month validity, a 10-day inspection after probate, and EMD due at clear-to-close [Flipping Mastery TV — K_L_G6jbyAE @ 00:12:08].

fields.name: attorney_stance
fields.prompt: Decide how you will treat the estate's probate attorney on a wholesale deal: as a closing partner or as a party to work around. Explain who the attorney actually represents and how you will verify the correct sale process in your state.
fields.example: Michael Franke notes you may pay for or assist with the process, but the attorney represents the family, not you [Michael Franke — iJVCVwX-rmA @ 00:08:06]. Verify the sale process in order through the state probate-court website, the title company, then a real estate attorney before accepting appraisal or BPO demands [Rick Ginn — OMiXHCnv8tU @ 00:07:36].

fields.name: buyer_access_and_speed
fields.prompt: Describe how cash buyers will tour the vacant probate house without coordinating with a distant personal representative, and how you will price speed into the deal. Include rekey costs, lockbox setup, and where any premium for a fast close is paid.
fields.example: Rekey the vacant house through a locksmith for $50 to $75, then install a lockbox so cash buyers can tour without the out-of-state PR [Flip With Rick — e3YN7RJaj6U @ 02:40:26]. A buyer may pay $10,000 more for a faster close, with proceeds going to the estate account [Rick Ginn — LqNx0dBk2f8 @ 00:51:04].

fields.name: pipeline_persistence
fields.prompt: Set your expected response rate on probate letters, the number of offers you must make per deal, and how many months you will mail before judging results. Note how you will handle the slow holiday season when competitors go quiet.
fields.example: Expect 1 to 2 calls per 100 pieces; 3 to 4 months without a deal is normal, and most people quit at 45 days [Rick Ginn — WU_DwL7k5ZE @ 00:38:32]. Fifteen offers get one deal [Real Estate Skills — M9iyZc2j_uQ @ 01:19:00]. Mail through the holidays, when December lead counts drop about 38% and competition idles [Probate Mastery — AAF69oF79DU @ 00:02:29].

fields.name: senior_authority_and_contact
fields.prompt: Before listing a senior's home, document who holds power of attorney or whether the senior will sign directly, and name the single family contact. Explain how this setup shortens the timeline from first family meeting to closing for everyone involved.
fields.example: No senior listing without a power of attorney or the senior signing, plus one designated family contact [Florida Realtors YouTube — yyvDp4R_T84 @ 00:02:16]. With both in place, Sheri Coleman reports the cycle can run as short as six weeks from family meeting to closing in Vero Beach [Florida Realtors YouTube — yyvDp4R_T84 @ 00:01:01]. Educate everyone on pricing early.

fields.name: senior_sale_payoffs_and_care_funding
fields.prompt: List every payoff the senior's sale must cover, including any reverse mortgage balance, and the monthly care cost the proceeds will fund. Estimate how many months of private pay the net proceeds provide before other funding must step in.
fields.example: Any reverse mortgage must be paid off at closing. Bay Area assisted living or memory care runs $5,000 to $12,000-plus per month [Simplify Senior Transitions with Dale Corpus — S5zYm8kcrug @ 00:02:35]. Families need two years of private pay saved to stay under Medicaid [Discover Colorado - The Cobb Home Team — 1kkoh35VCho @ 00:00:36].

fields.name: ral_zoning_and_debt_check
fields.prompt: If you plan to redeploy probate commissions into rentals or a residential assisted living home, record your zoning verification, site plan, marketing plan to fill beds, and debt service coverage ratio. Explain which check must clear before any offer is made.
fields.example: No offer until planning and zoning confirms the use for that exact address [Serg Lupescu — JUTV80jUHSI @ 00:03:53]. Brett Chotkevys spent $240 on a rough site plan to learn exactly what is allowed [Brett Chotkevys — fFnH_VM4S48 @ 00:02:51]. Rentals need a debt service coverage ratio of roughly 1.2 [Unit Math — i8GDo8WTXWw @ 00:07:03]. Budget for paid placement-agent leads.

worksheets.completion_gate: Complete when the filing window and source, first-call plan, anchored price, deposit and terms, letters verification and re-papering dates, attorney stance, buyer access plan, persistence targets, senior authority and payoff figures, and zoning and debt checks are all recorded with concrete numbers.
